values: 挥动武器，每秒对邻格敌人造成伤害。
Brutus spins his sword, dealing damage to adjacent enemies every second.
在4秒内挥动武器高速旋转，每秒对周围1格的敌人造成110% + 15% ATK的伤害。技能释放期间布鲁特斯处于霸体状态。
Brutus spins Mountain's Roar at high speed and deals 110% + 15% ATK damage every second to adjacent enemies for 4s. He is unaffected while spinning.
技能释放期间布鲁特斯还会免疫所有伤害，并且不消耗布鲁特斯其他技能免疫伤害效果的持续时间。
Gains damage immunity when spinning. This skill effect does not affect the duration of other damage immunities granted by his other skills.
怒吼，嘲讽附近的敌人，并降低他们的护甲。
Brutus roars, taunting nearby enemies and reducing their Phys DEF.
发出怒吼，嘲讽周围2格内的敌人1.5 + 0.5秒，并使他们在9秒内下降15%的护甲。
Brutus roars with rage, taunting surrounding enemies within 2 tiles for 1.5 + 0.5s and reducing their Phys DEF by 15% for 9s.
下降护甲的幅度提升至20%。
Reduces surrounding enemies' Phys DEF by 20%.
下降护甲的幅度提升至25%。
Reduces surrounding enemies' Phys DEF by 25%.
下降护甲的幅度提升至30%。
Reduces surrounding enemies' Phys DEF by 30%.
免疫首次最后一击，并且在数秒内免疫物理与魔法伤害。
Brutus is immune to the first fatal blow, and physical and magic damage for a short time.
布鲁特斯首次受到最后一击时，免疫这次伤害，并且在5 + 1秒内免疫所有伤害，并处于霸体状态。
Brutus is immune to the first fatal blow he receives. He is then immune to all damage and becomes unaffected for 5 + 1s
还会在免疫伤害的期间内增加25点生命汲取与25%的攻击力。
Gains 25 Life Drain and 25% ATK during immunity.
还会在免疫伤害的期间内增加35点生命汲取与30%的攻击力。
Gains 35 Life Drain and 30% ATK during immunity.
还会在免疫伤害的期间内增加35点生命汲取与35%的攻击力。
Gains 35 Life Drain and 35% ATK during immunity.
提高自身生命汲取，释放大招时生命汲取进一步提高。
Brutus increases his Life Drain during battle, and it further increases when using Whirlwind Wrath.
战斗中，自身的生命汲取提升10点，释放终极技能时，自身生命汲取额外提升5点。
Brutus increases his Life Drain by 10 during battle. He gains an extra 5 Life Drain when casting Whirlwind Wrath.
战斗中，自身的生命汲取提升13点，释放终极技能时，自身生命汲取额外提升7点。
Brutus increases his Life Drain by 13 during battle. He gains an extra 7 Life Drain when casting Whirlwind Wrath.
战斗中，自身的生命汲取提升16点，释放终极技能时，自身生命汲取额外提升8点。
Brutus increases his Life Drain by 16 during battle. He gains an extra 8 Life Drain when casting Whirlwind Wrath.
每承受来自邻格一定次数的物理攻击，便可以大力顺劈，对面前小范围内的敌人造成大量伤害，附带生命汲取效果。
Brutus cleaves enemies in front and gains Life Drain after receiving physical damage several times from adjacent enemies.
每承受10次来自1格以内的物理伤害，便可以发动一次威力巨大的“顺劈斩”。“顺劈斩”对前方1格扇形区域内的敌人造成200% ATK外加目标12%最大生命值的伤害（总伤害不超过750% ATK），附带30%的生命汲取效果。布鲁特斯每5秒至多发动1次顺劈斩。

Brutus cleaves with all his might to enemies within a 1-tile arc in front after receiving physical damage 10 times from adjacent enemies, dealing 200% ATK damage plus 12% of the target's max HP. The total damage cannot exceed 750% ATK. Brutus also gains 30% Life Drain. This skill can be triggered once every 5s.
顺劈斩的伤害提升至230% ATK外加目标最大生命值的12%（总伤害不超过780% ATK）。
Increases damage to 230% ATK plus 12% of the target's max HP (the total damage cannot exceed 780% ATK).
顺劈斩的释放不再受时间间隔的约束，每承受10次来自1格以内的物理伤害，便可以发动一次威力巨大的“顺劈斩”。
Removes the cooldown limit for this skill. Brutus can cast this skill for every 10 physical damage attacks he receives from adjacent enemies.
顺劈斩的伤害提升至260% ATK外加目标最大生命值的12%（总伤害不超过780% ATK）。
Increases damage to 260% ATK plus 12% of the target's max HP (the total damage cannot exceed 780% ATK).
技能“不屈”持续时间时间增加。
Brutus increases the skill duration of Indomitable.
技能“不屈”免疫所有伤害和霸体状态的持续时间增加1秒。
Brutus increases the duration of damage immunity and unaffected status from Indomitable by 1s.
